page.title: Tags
page.subtitle: Labels shared across every object in the app.
page.emptyDesc: Create a tag, then attach it to projects, components, storages and more.
page.objectsEmpty: Nothing is tagged with this yet.

tags.confirmDelete: Delete tag «{name}»? It is attached to {count} objects.

errors.invalidRef: «{ref}» is not a valid object reference.
errors.targetNotFound: The object «{ref}» does not exist or is out of scope.
errors.nameTooLong: Tag name is too long — {max} characters at most.

list_tags.description: List all tags with how many objects each is attached to. Optionally filter by a name substring.

params.query: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter tag names by.

get_object_tags.description: List the tags currently attached to one object, given its canonical object reference (mk://…).

params.ref: Canonical object reference of the object whose tags to read.

find_objects_by_tag.description: Find every object attached to a given tag, resolved to name and location. Fails for an unknown tag; an empty result means the tag exists but is unused.

params.tag: Tag id, name, or mk://tags/tag/<id> reference to look up.

create_tag.description: Create a new tag in the shared vocabulary.

params.name: The tag name (must be unique).
params.color: Optional colour tone for the tag chip.

update_tag.description: Rename a tag and/or change its colour. Affects the tag everywhere it is used.

params.tag: Tag id, name, or mk://tags/tag/<id> reference to update.
params.name: New name for the tag.
params.color: New colour tone for the tag chip.

assign_tag.description: Attach a tag to any object by its canonical reference. Creates the tag if the given name does not exist yet.

params.tag: Tag id, name (created if unknown), or mk://tags/tag/<id> reference.
params.ref: Canonical object reference (mk://…) of the object to tag.

unassign_tag.description: Remove a tag from one object. The tag itself is kept.

params.tag: Tag id, name, or mk://tags/tag/<id> reference to remove.
params.ref: Canonical object reference (mk://…) of the object to untag.

delete_tag.description: Delete a tag from the vocabulary and detach it from every object.

params.tag: Tag id, name, or mk://tags/tag/<id> reference to delete.

sources.label: Values of this field become tags
sources.hint: The value is added as a tag when the item is created. It is not kept in sync afterwards.
